requirements.quote: Supplier shall propose a factory acceptance test (FAT) procedure covering every requirement and obtain approval before PVT.
requirements.text: Propose and get approval for FAT procedure before PVT.

requirements.quote: Escapes, retests and rework shall remain visible in the original serial history.
requirements.text: Ensure escapes, retests, and rework are traceable in serial history.

requirements.quote: Electrical and interface test: 100% units: input current at 18/24/36 VDC, both Ethernet links at negotiated 1 Gbit/s, both RS-485 ports, LEDs, USB, memory and watchdog. Record numeric limits and readings.
requirements.text: Perform electrical and interface tests on all units and record results.

requirements.quote: Identity and software test: 100% units: unique serial/MAC/certificate pairing; firmware hash; secure boot status; debug lock; provisioned key presence; no secret-key export. Reject duplicates.
requirements.text: Test identity and software on all units, ensuring uniqueness and security.

requirements.quote: Burn-in and final functional test: 100% units: four hours at 50 C running the Section 6.1 workload, then final test at room temperature. Zero unexplained restart, communication failure or test-limit breach.
requirements.text: Conduct burn-in and final functional tests on all units under specified conditions.

requirements.quote: Lot inspection: ISO 2859-1 normal single sampling, general level II: major AQL 0.65, minor AQL 1.5. Select sample and Ac/Re numbers from actual lot size. Safety, identity and wrong-configuration checks are 100% with zero defects.
requirements.text: Perform lot inspection per ISO 2859-1 standards with specified AQLs.

requirements.quote: Rejected lots: Quarantine the lot; investigate; perform 100% screening of affected attributes and rework; resubmit with fresh lot sampling. No shipment on failed inspection without buyer concession.
requirements.text: Handle rejected lots with quarantine, investigation, rework, and resubmission.

requirements.quote: Retain genealogy and raw test records for seven years after shipment.
requirements.text: Keep test records for seven years post-shipment.

requirements.quote: Export CSV/JSON using at least: serial_number, model, hardware_revision, pcb_lot, firmware_hash, test_station, calibration_due, UTC_timestamp, test_id, lower_limit, measured_value, upper_limit, result and operator_id.
requirements.text: Provide test records in CSV/JSON format with specified fields.

requirements.quote: Restrict access and maintain tamper-evident backups.
requirements.text: Ensure restricted access and tamper-evident backups for records.

requirements.quote: Two business days before dispatch, submit the signed conformity certificate, serial list, test summary, concessions, firmware manifest and packing list.
requirements.text: Submit required documents two business days before dispatch.

requirements.quote: Contain faults within 24 hours; provide root cause in five business days and close corrective action in 15 business days.
